body: A US MV-22 Osprey transport aircraft made an emergency landing at Ishigaki Airport at about 6:50 p.m. on November 19. According to the Okinawa Defense Bureau and others, the aircraft is believed to have flown in from the Philippines and landed after an apparent malfunction. No injuries were confirmed and there was no effect on civilian flights.

Okinawa Governor Genta Koshō said on November 20 that he had instructed officials to gather information on the cause and that he would seek thorough safety management from the US side. Defense Minister Shinjirō Koizumi said after a cabinet meeting the same day that ensuring safety is the top priority in the operation of US military aircraft and that Japan will ask the US to take every measure to ensure safety management.
en.summary: A US MV-22 Osprey transport aircraft made an emergency landing at Ishigaki Airport on the evening of November 19 after an apparent malfunction. No one was injured and civilian flights were unaffected; Okinawa Governor Genta Koshō and Defense Minister Shinjirō Koizumi both called on the US to ensure thorough safety management on November 20.
en.title: US MV-22 Osprey makes emergency landing at Ishigaki Airport

body: 美軍MV-22魚鷹運輸機11月19日傍晚在石垣機場緊急著陸。據防衛省沖繩防衛局等單位表示，該機當天下午6時50分左右由菲律賓方向飛來，疑似因機體故障而緊急著陸，未確認有人受傷，民航機也未受影響。
沖繩縣知事古謝玄太11月20日表示，已指示蒐集事件原因相關資訊，並將要求美方徹底安全管理。防衛大臣小泉進次郎同日在內閣會議後記者會上強調，美軍機運用以確保安全為大前提，將要求美方在安全管理上做到萬全。
zh.summary: 美軍MV-22魚鷹運輸機11月19日傍晚因疑似故障在石垣機場緊急著陸，無人受傷，民航未受影響；沖繩縣知事古謝玄太與防衛大臣小泉進次郎11月20日先後要求美方徹底安全管理。
zh.title: 美軍MV-22魚鷹機石垣機場緊急著陸、沖繩知事要求徹底安全管理
